tools.name: list_dossiers
tools.description: List all Octopus dossiers (company files) accessible to the authenticated user. Returns dossier IDs, descriptions, VAT numbers, and addresses. Use this to find the correct dossier ID for configuration.

tools.name: get_bookyears
tools.description: Get all bookyears (boekjaren) for the configured Octopus dossier. Returns bookyear IDs, descriptions, start/end dates, periods, and whether they are closed. Use the bookyear ID in other calls that require it.

tools.name: list_relations
tools.description: List all relations (clients and suppliers) in the configured Octopus dossier. Returns names, addresses, VAT numbers, bank accounts, contact details, and payment terms. Note: this endpoint is limited to 2 calls per day.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts (rekeningschema) for a specific bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Returns account numbers, descriptions, VAT settings, and cost centre configuration. Requires a bookyear_id. Note: limited to 2 calls per day.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to get accounts for. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: List all journals (dagboeken) for a specific bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Returns journal keys (e.g. A1=Buy, V1=Sell, F1=Financial, D1=Divers), names, currency, and last booked document number. Requires a bookyear_id.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to get journals for. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

tools.name: list_buy_sell_bookings
tools.description: Get buy or sell bookings (aan-/verkoopboekingen) from the configured Octopus dossier. Can filter by bookyear, journal, and document number. Returns booking details including relation, amounts, VAT, booking lines, and dates.

bookyear_id.description: Filter by bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (e.g. 'A1' for buy journal, 'V1' for sell journal). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Filter by specific document sequence number within a journal.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Get invoices (facturen) from the configured Octopus dossier. Can filter by bookyear, journal, and document number. Returns invoice details including relation, lines with products/quantities/prices, VAT, and dates. Note: requires the Invoice Module to be activated in the dossier.

bookyear_id.description: Filter by bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (e.g. 'V1' for sell invoices). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Filter by specific document sequence number within a journal.

tools.name: create_relation
tools.description: Create or update a relation (client/supplier) in the configured Octopus dossier. If a relation with the given relation_id or external_relation_id already exists, it will be updated (upsert). Otherwise a new relation is created. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

name.description: Full name of the relation (company or person name)

client.description: Whether this relation is a client (customer)

supplier.description: Whether this relation is a supplier

vat_number.description: VAT number. For Belgian companies use format BE0xxx.xxx.xxx

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key (for updating an existing relation)

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID from your system (for matching/updating)

tools.name: create_buy_sell_booking
tools.description: Create a buy or sell booking (aan-/verkoopboeking) in the configured Octopus dossier. Use journal_key 'A1' for buy bookings, 'V1' for sell bookings. For credit notes, set amount to negative (but keep line amounts positive). First use get_bookyears to find the bookyear_id and list_journals to find the journal_key. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'A1' for buy, 'V1' for sell). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal. Check list_journals for the last booked document number.

period_nr.description: Bookyear period number (usually 1-12 for monthly periods)

expiry_date.description: Payment expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amount.description: Total booking amount (negative for credit notes)

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the client/supplier

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the client/supplier

booking_lines.description: Booking lines with account details, amounts, and VAT

account_key.description: Account number (e.g. 600000 for purchases, 700000 for sales)

vat_code.description: VAT code (e.g. '21' for 21% VAT, '06' for 6%, 'D21' for deductible 21%)

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a sell invoice (verkoopfactuur) in the configured Octopus dossier. Requires the Invoice Module to be activated. Uses V-journals (sell journals). For credit notes, both total and line amounts must be negative. At least one invoice_line is required. First use get_bookyears and list_journals to find the right IDs. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Sell journal code (e.g. 'V1'). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

expiry_date.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the customer

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the customer

invoice_lines.description: Invoice lines with product details, quantities, and prices

tools.name: create_financial_divers_booking
tools.description: Create a financial or divers booking in the configured Octopus dossier. Use journal_key 'F1' for financial journals, 'D1' for divers. Each booking line must specify a type: 'A' for account line, 'C' for client line, 'S' for supplier line. At least one booking_line is required. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'F1' for financial, 'D1' for divers). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

booking_lines.description: Booking lines. Each line must have a type ('A'=Account, 'C'=Client, 'S'=Supplier) and an amount.

type.description: 'A' for account line, 'C' for client line, 'S' for supplier line

relation_id.description: Relation ID (required when type is 'C' or 'S')

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID (alternative to relation_id for type 'C' or 'S')

amount.description: Amount (positive for debit, negative for credit)

octopus_password.label: Octopus wachtwoord
octopus_password.description: Het wachtwoord van je Octopus account

software_house_id.label: Software House ID
software_house_id.description: Software House UUID verkregen van Octopus (aanvragen via webservice@octopus.be)

dossier_id.label: Dossier ID
dossier_id.description: Het Octopus dossier-ID waarmee gewerkt wordt. Gebruik de 'list_dossiers' tool om beschikbare dossiers te vinden.
